text:
maya: Heads-up — deploybot flagged a canary p95 regression after the v3.5.0 rollout. Suggests fallback but suppressed autopilot because of noisy signals. Can ops + release own this?

devon: saw the alert. metrics look like p95 +220ms on generator path, embeddings fine. canary slice 5%. no customer-facing errors yet.

ops-bot: telemetry dump: canary_slice=5% error_rate=1.9% baseline=0.7% p95_increase=+220ms region=usw2

ryan: if we go manual fallback we need operator handshake (to avoid double-reverts). i'm +1 for manual rollback if we see sustained p95 reg >200ms for 5m.

maya: agreed. criteria: (1) p95 delta >200ms sustained for 5m, (2) no transient infra noise, (3) ops handshake complete, (4) release-notes/comms owner assigned.

sasha: i'll own comms/release notes. if we roll back we need a short customer blurb and a changelog line explaining revert to v3.4.1; will coordinate with support.

devon: quick triage — looks like attention-kernel change in 3.5.0 under long-context paths. replicates on staging. ops, do you want me to back out kernel flag or full revert?

ryan: prefer full revert for safety. manual rollback command: `/deploy revert --to v3.4.1 --reason "canary p95 regression" --operator ryan --force`

maya: calling operator handshake: @ryan you have authority to execute? @sasha can you prepare draft? Devon to stand by for kernel follow-up if we need a targeted patch.

ryan: I have authority. executing in 30s. will post status.

deploybot: Received request to revert rollout. Verifying prechecks...

deploybot: Prechecks passed — target version v3.4.1 available, migrations none, pinned artifacts ok. Starting revert traffic plan: immediate canary -> rollback -> 0->gradual drain of v3.5.0.

ryan: ran `/deploy revert --to v3.4.1 --reason "canary p95 regression" --operator ryan --force` — command acknowledged.

deploybot: Revert in progress: canary roll back initiated. estimated completion ~4m. will post final status.

maya: sasha, ping customer-success & sales with this note (draft): "We reverted a recent rollout due to observed latency regression in a canary slice; default traffic restored to v3.4.1. No data loss expected. We’ll follow up with timeline for a stable v3.5.0 patch."

sasha: sending now. cc @support. draft sent to #customer-success for review.

deploybot: Revert complete. rollout state: active=v3.4.1, inactive=v3.5.0, canary=0%.

ryan: rollback completed, p95 back to baseline in 2m. leaving notes in the release ticket. will open follow-up issue to investigate attention kernel change.

maya: thanks team. post-mortem + follow-up patch plan: devon + ryan to own investigation, sasha to finalize customer comms, ops to monitor for 24h. :thumbsup:
